scripts.fmt: bunx prettier --write apps/web/src apps/web/index.html package.json apps/web/package.json tsconfig.json apps/web/tsconfig.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json
scripts.fmt:check: bunx prettier --check apps/web/src apps/web/index.html package.json apps/web/package.json tsconfig.json apps/web/tsconfig.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json
scripts.ci: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run check && bun run web:build && make -C apps/backend ci
